description: Output of ``tutor_answer`` v4: v3 plus optional layout (ADR 0028).

segments.description: The answer in reading order; [] if nothing is covered.

items.description: ``tutor_answer`` v4: a segment may sit under a heading or in a table cell.

text.description: One or two sentences of the answer, supported by the cited excerpts.

sources.description: Excerpt labels that support this text, e.g. ["S1", "S3"]. Never empty.

section.description: Optional heading this segment sits under, e.g. "Findings".

row.description: Table row label (a feature, or a diagnosis); set with column.

column.description: Table column label (an entity compared, or a discriminator heading).

coverage.description: How completely the excerpts answer the question.
